Kissaten Engine: A cozy idle-game engine. STYLE LOCK: Cozy cat mobile game in the style of Meow Tower (Hyperbeard).

Warm, sunny, cheerful colour: soft but saturated, never neon, never muted or grey. Cats are white with a few small grey or orange patches, a wide head, small rounded ears set wide, tiny dark dot eyes set wide apart, a tiny mouth, no outline, no tail.

EDGES: NO OUTLINES. No dark contour line around any shape. Shapes are separated by colour alone. Where a shape meets a similar colour, it has a slightly darker band of its own hue along its lower or outer edge (a wall with a darker apricot base band, a roof with a darker red lip, a window with a darker wood frame). Edges are soft and very slightly brushy, not hard vector edges. Inner detail is a darker same-hue shape, never a dark line. The only dark colour is tiny facial features.

SHADING: Soft cel shading, not flat. Every form has a darker same-hue band on its lower or shadow side (a bulging floor slab is lighter at the top and darker at the bottom lip) and a gentle lighter tone along its top edge or rounded top. Subtle gradients are allowed: a soft falloff inside a shaded band, a gentle top-to-bottom gradient on small rounded props, and a small soft highlight dot on round props.
